releaseNotes: Textblock löschen now opens a LuMa confirmation dialog with Abbrechen and Löschen before any text is removed
A dedicated BOOX-safe resize handle restores manual text block resizing without relying on the browser-native resize implementation
Text blocks once again grow automatically to the right while space is available and then downward as text wraps
Manual and automatic width/height changes are persisted immediately and remain canonical across tool switches
The stable text options row from 0.12.13 remains unchanged in its current position
Empty text block cleanup remains enabled
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
